> 第十二章 奇异空间（第1页）
不知道过了多久，冯斗终于恢复好了体内的灵气，他此时看到了自己低价买到一块石头。
他当时一看到这一块石头，他就有一种感觉，那就是让他灵气海之中的那一股空间力不断波动啊！
他觉得这块不起眼的石头绝对不是眼前的那么简单的，他才决定买下来，自己再详细地观察一下。
他此时突破了修为，他觉得自己可以试探一下这一块石头，到底是什么情况，毕竟只有这样才可以做到准确无误的。
他再次运起灵气，然而当他的灵气一进入那块石头，冯斗马上就意识到空间力不断地将他控制住，他此时被直接拖进一个隐匿的空间。
他感觉到这里的时间流速变得更加快了，他发觉这里的灵气要比外面强上两三倍，此时一个声音传出来：“年轻人，你好！”
“也许现在已经没有太多人知道我的存在，曾经有人称呼我为幻仙，我在你的身上感受到我的血脉之力。”
“我们到底是什么人呢？你能够告诉我吗？”
“年轻人，有些东西还是不能够让你所知道。不过这里的流速与外边相差是一比一年的，你完全可以在这里修炼。”
当冯斗听到这一番话时，他不由得非常之惊讶，他万万没有想到这里居然能够修炼圣地，他虽然是非常之吃惊，但是他不傻，他当然知道一旦自己拥有这个空间宝物的消息传出去，他必定会成为一块香饽饽。
对方仿佛已经看透了冯斗内心深处的想法，“你可以放心，我已经将这个空间宝物放在你的灵气海之中，这个世界上能够看到你的空间宝物的人为数不多，你尽可以放心，不到万不得已！你是绝对不会暴露的。”
“还有就是你可以在这里学习功法，这里集中了我毕生的所有功法，当然有些高级功法，你还没有达到这样的级别，所以暂时不可以这样急功近利啦！”
当冯斗听到这一番话时，他不由得内心激起小浪花，这对于他来说不一定是好事，也不一定是坏事，到底是最后什么样的情况都不可而知。
此时冯斗马上开始运功，因为他希望自己能够尽快地突破现在的修为，最好能够突破掉灵动境，只有这样才能够有自保的能力！
冯斗感觉到整个空间的灵气变得非常充分，一点也不像是外面的世界，可是冯斗感觉到自己修炼的速度飞速地运转。
那个自称“幻仙”的人不断地指导冯斗修炼，然而此时的冯斗算得上事半功倍，冯斗内心不由得想：这个自称幻仙的人，真的是越来越强大，他的修为绝对是超过我的所认识的范围。
经过了接近三年的修炼之后，他发觉自己已经无限地接近突破灵动境，同时他意识到一点，那就是他哪怕是在这里修炼再久也不一定能够突破灵动境。
因为想从灵动境突破到仙机境，不是单纯修炼就可以的，也许一场生死大战就可以足够突破所需要啦！
只有真正的生死大战，才能够激发自己的体内所含的潜能，只有这样才可以做到自己的潜力无限化。
冯斗马上向“幻仙”寻求出去的方法，“幻仙”却说：“以后进出这个空间，只有你的精神力集中就可以进入，不需要你的肉体进入啦！”

> Chapter 12 Strange Space (Page 1)
I don't know how long it took, but Feng Dou finally recovered the spiritual energy in his body. At this time, he saw that he had bought a stone at a low price.
As soon as he saw this stone, he had a feeling that the space force in his spiritual energy sea was constantly fluctuating!
He felt that this inconspicuous stone was definitely not as simple as it seemed, so he decided to buy it and observe it in detail himself.
He had achieved a breakthrough in cultivation at this time, and he felt that he could test this stone to see what it was like. After all, only in this way could it be accurate.
He activated his spiritual energy again, but as soon as his spiritual energy entered the stone, Feng Dou immediately realized that the space force was constantly controlling him, and he was dragged directly into a hidden space.
He felt that the flow of time here became faster, and he found that the spiritual energy here was two or three times stronger than outside. At this time, a voice came out: "Hello, young man!"
"Perhaps not many people know my existence now. Some people once called me Huanxian. I feel the power of my blood in you."
"Who are we? Can you tell me?"
"Young man, there are some things that I still can't let you know. However, the flow rate here is one year behind the outside. You can definitely practice here."
When Feng Dou heard these words, he couldn't help but be very surprised. He never thought that this could be a holy land for cultivation. Although he was very surprised, he was not stupid. Of course, he knew that once the news of his possession of this spatial treasure spread, he would definitely become a piece of cake.
The other party seemed to have seen through Feng Dou's innermost thoughts, "You can rest assured that I have placed this spatial treasure in your spiritual energy sea. There are only a few people in this world who can see your spatial treasure. You can rest assured, unless it is absolutely necessary! You will never be exposed."
"Also, you can learn the skills here. All the skills I have learned throughout my life are concentrated here. Of course, there are some advanced skills. You haven't reached this level yet, so you can't be so eager for quick success for the time being!"
When Feng Dou heard these words, he couldn't help but feel a little stir in his heart. This is not necessarily a good thing or a bad thing for him. It is unknown what the final situation will be.
At this time, Feng Dou immediately started to exercise his power, because he hoped that he could break through his current cultivation level as soon as possible, and it would be best to break through the spiritual realm. Only in this way can he have the ability to protect himself!
Feng Dou felt that the spiritual energy in the entire space had become very full, and it was not like the outside world at all, but Feng Dou felt that the speed of his cultivation was running rapidly.
The person who calls himself "Huanxian" continues to guide Feng Dou in his cultivation. However, at this time, Feng Dou can get twice the result with half the effort. Feng Dou can't help but think in his heart: This person who calls himself Huanxian is really getting stronger and stronger. His cultivation is definitely beyond the scope of what I know.
After nearly three years of practice, he found that he was infinitely close to breaking through to the spiritual realm. At the same time, he realized that no matter how long he practiced here, he might not be able to break through to the spiritual realm.
Because if you want to break through from the Spiritual Movement Realm to the Immortal Mechanism Realm, you can’t just practice cultivation. Maybe a life-and-death battle will be enough to break through!
Only a real life-and-death battle can stimulate the potential contained in one's body. Only in this way can one's potential be unlimited.
Feng Dou immediately asked "Huanxian" for a way out, but "Huanxian" said: "In the future, you can enter this space only by concentrating your mental power, and you don't need to enter with your body!"
